| **2 Recovery of established evolutionary explanations** | Explicit transmission models and the new two-type recurrence correspondence. | Correspondences covering the claimed selection, mutation, drift, movement, inheritance and ecological mechanisms, with valid ranges and failures. Mathematical claims require actual Lean checks. An abstract interface alone is insufficient. |

| **3 Evolution of the conditions of evolution** | Actual output determines reconstruction, and inherited retention changes development. Retention, packing and aggregation constrain sorting. A bacterial genealogy and directly linked reversion assay now connect inherited switching to actual cycle completion and subsequent lineage representation under a declared regime. Separate oxygen experiments establish activity-generated gradients and condition-dependent competitive outcomes. | Generalize and calibrate these connections with supported renewal, mixing and stochastic occurrence. Explain mutation, transmission and replacement contributions to prevalence; fixation alone is not causal proof. Laboratory protocol changes do not establish endogenous evolution of the selector. |

| **4 Novel organization and changed evolutionary units** | The completed [new-possibilities integration](NEW-POSSIBILITIES.md) distinguishes installed construction from encompassing law, gives a formed constructor and scope-specific description revision. The association model adds formed group relations; empirical aggregation distinguishes temporary sorting groups from inherited organizations. | Credit those results and connect formation to inherited retention and ongoing effect under actual evolutionary conditions. Common transport does not alone establish a new inherited unit. Broader changes of evolutionary units and sustained qualitative innovation require their own mechanisms and evidence. |

| **5 Demonstrated comparative strength** | Exact recurrence correspondence and a proved limit of snapshots omitting bonds. Dated assay transfer exposes stage-specific prediction failures. | Establish a consequential gain against an adequately specified rival with matched evidence and assumptions. Neither the reduced baselines nor disagreement between unvalidated velocity approximations establishes superior prediction. Measure sorting and descendants to decide the physical correspondence. Broad empirical superiority remains unestablished. |

| **6 Ethical continuation and evolved evaluation** | The [practical-judgment candidate](PRACTICAL-JUDGMENT.md) is complete and independently accepted at its explicit-axiom general-principles scope, with G0 and additional comparison/responsibility commitments disclosed. | Credit that completed scope; connect evolved evaluation to its actual recognition, calibration and implementation, preserving failures.
